rationale: The original thesis is intact — price ($33.59) remains well below VWAP ($33.75), below the $33.80 invalidation, and the 1.60% gap is unfaded, with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.36%, VIXY +1.36%) still favoring the fade toward $33.15. The bounce off the session low is a five-candle grind on steadily evaporating volume (11.6k→5.5k per 1m bar), which reads as low-conviction short-covering rather than reversal buying; the 9-EMA reclaim alone doesn't justify exiting ahead of the defined stop. Risk to the $33.80 stop is roughly $50 on a small position, well inside the remaining $488.80 loss budget, while the $33.15 target still offers ~2:1 reward-to-risk from here.
